about: GTA 6 took thirteen years: GTA 5 (Sep 17, 2013) to GTA 6 (Nov 19, 2026), the two delays crossed out on a timeline. Delta channel, SAFE-EDIT compliant: own graphics, own voice, no Rockstar footage.

lines.say: G T A six took thirteen years.
G T A five came out September seventeenth, twenty thirteen.
G T A six lands on November nineteenth, twenty twenty six.

lines.text: That's thirteen years and two months.
GTA 5 launched on PlayStation 3. GTA 6 is for PlayStation 5.
lines.say: G T A five launched on PlayStation three. G T A six is for PlayStation five.

lines.text: The longest wait before? About 5.4 years.
lines.say: The longest wait before? About five point four years.

lines.text: And it was supposed to land in fall 2025.
lines.say: And it was supposed to land in fall twenty twenty five.

lines.text: Then, on May 2, Rockstar said May 26, 2026.
lines.say: Then, on May second, Rockstar said May twenty sixth, twenty twenty six.

lines.text: Then on November 6, it moved again.
lines.say: Then on November sixth, it moved again.

lines.text: Two delays. And the date has held since.
So, are you playing day one?
